metadata.title: fix(oauth): honor advisory contract and accept array-shaped scope/scp
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #4213

---

## 📝 Summary

Two small regressions in the OAuth token claim validator introduced in #3941 break tool fetching for non-conforming IdPs:

1. `_validate_scopes` calls `.split()` on the `scope` / `scp` claim, which crashes when the IdP emits an array (Ory Hydra, Keycloak, some Auth0 configurations).
2. `gateway_service.py::fetch_tools_after_oauth` raises `GatewayConnectionError` on any mismatched claim, contradicting the module's own "advisory — the upstream MCP server remains the authoritative validator" contract stated in `token_validation_service.py`.

This PR:
- Normalizes array-shaped `scope`/`scp` to a space-separated string before tokenization.
- Wraps each `_validate_*` call in its own `try / except` so one crashing validator cannot abort siblings or propagate to the caller; crashes become non-blocking warnings.
- Downgrades the hard-block in `fetch_tools_after_oauth` to a `logger.warning` that preserves the existing operator guidance (`Fix oauth_config(resource/scopes/issuer) …`). The upstream MCP server remains the authoritative validator, per the module docstring.

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
- Reproduced end-to-end against **Amplitude's public MCP server** (`https://mcp.amplitude.com/mcp`, Ory Hydra-backed, issuer `https://auth.amplitude.com`) which emits `scp` as an array and `aud` as an empty list even when the client sends RFC 8707 `resource=` on both `/authorize` and `/token`. Full decoded JWT claims (from a direct DCR + PKCE flow, bypassing ContextForge) are included in #4213.
- The previous "Refusing to forward OAuth token … Fix oauth_config …" diagnostic is preserved as a warning log, so operators still get the remediation hint when a mismatch is genuinely their misconfiguration.
- If reviewers prefer to keep the strict blocking behavior available to deployments that want it, happy to follow up with an opt-in `oauth_config.strict_claim_validation` flag — did not include it here to keep the change focused on the regression.

commits.message:
fix(oauth): honor advisory contract and accept array-shaped scope/scp

The OAuth token claim validation added in #3941 and hardened in
follow-up commit 143aaf63a has two issues that break tool fetching for
non-conforming IdPs:

1. `_validate_scopes` unconditionally calls `.split()` on the `scope` /
   `scp` claim.  Ory Hydra (used e.g. by Amplitude's MCP server),
   Keycloak, and some Auth0 configurations emit this claim as a JSON
   array, which crashed the validator with
   `AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'split'` and returned
   400 from `/oauth/fetch-tools`.

2. The `token_validation_service` module docstring declares the
   validator to be "best-effort advisory — the upstream MCP server
   remains the authoritative validator", but `gateway_service.py`
   raised `GatewayConnectionError` on any mismatched claim, turning the
   advisory checks into a hard gate.  IdPs that do not perfectly follow
   RFC 9068 / RFC 8707 (Amplitude omits the RFC 8707 resource echo,
   Authentik emits aud=client_id, etc.) became unusable.

Changes:

- Normalize list-shaped `scope` / `scp` claims to a space-separated
  string before tokenization, so `_normalize_scope` continues to
  receive a `str`.
- Wrap each `_validate_*` call in its own try/except so an unexpected
  claim shape cannot abort sibling checks or propagate to the caller.
  Crashes are recorded as non-blocking warnings for operator visibility.
- Replace the `raise GatewayConnectionError("Refusing to forward OAuth
  token …")` in `fetch_tools_after_oauth` with a warning log that
  preserves the existing operator-facing guidance ("Fix oauth_config
  …").  The upstream MCP server remains the authoritative validator,
  consistent with the module docstring.

Tests:

- `TestScopeClaimArrayShape`: happy / negative / edge coverage for
  list-shaped `scope` / `scp`, including URI-prefix normalization and
  empty-list (treated as absent).
- `TestValidatorAdvisoryContract`: per-validator crash isolation and
  non-blocking classification.
- Update the existing `fetch_tools_after_oauth` audience-mismatch test
  to verify the advisory forwarding behavior and the warning log
  content (advisory tag + mismatch detail + remediation hint).

Closes #4213

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>
